frames.heading: Lightningfist
frames.body: You have proven yourself, brave traveller. The rock spirit within you is undeniable. The Thunderstone awakens, and with it, the heart of Ampiforia beats once more!!

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: We did it, Gnork! Ampiforia's rock spirit is alive again!

frames.heading: Gnork
frames.body: You’ve got the true spirit of a rock legend.

frames.heading: Gnork
frames.body: It's rolling to the side... revealing something.

frames.heading: Celestial Amp
frames.body: For each planet I save, I get another amp! Maybe I can use these somehow...

frames.heading: Gnork
frames.body: Perhaps this amp is a symbol of your victory, and the key to spreading the rock spirit throughout the galaxy...

frames.heading: Goliath
frames.body: Your journey has inspired us all. The resonance of your music has shattered the chains of silence. Ampiforia shall once again echo with the sounds of rock.

frames.heading: Lightningfist
frames.body: Take the celestial amp, traveller. It will aid you in your quest to restore harmony across the stars. Remember the power of rock that brought us together.

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: Thank you, Lightningfist. Thank you, Gnork. And thank you, Goliaths. Together, we’ve made Ampiforia rock again. Now, it's time to bring this spirit to the next world - Grooveon!

frames.heading: Gnork
frames.body: Safe travels, my friend. And remember, wherever you go, let the music guide you.

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: Rock on, Gnork. Rock on, Ampiforia. To Grooveon I go!!!
